content: Term-frequency inverse document-frequency (TF-IDF): The weight of a term $w$ is defined by the multiplication of its term-frequency and its inverse document-frequency. When considering only the TF weights, all terms have the same importance among the corpus. By using the IDF weight, words that are more common across all documents in $D$ receive a smaller weight, giving more importance to rare terms in the corpus.
